justification: Inspected [src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/locks/LockingVisitors.java](./src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/locks/LockingVisitors.java), [src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/locks/LockingVisitorsTest.java](./src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/locks/LockingVisitorsTest.java), and [src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/locks/package-info.java](./src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/locks/package-info.java). The class has some fan-out (imports `Objects`, `Lock`, `ReadWriteLock`, `ReentrantLock`, `ReentrantReadWriteLock`, `StampedLock`, `Supplier`, and Commons `AbstractSupplier`/`Failable` helpers, plus nested visitor/builder types), but fan-in is very low: the repository search found direct references only in its dedicated test class, with no other production classes depending on it. That is not strong hub-like modularization.
